name: gh-actions
description: GitHub Actions runs, jobs and failed-step logs for the selected thread's pull request: rerun, cancel, send a failure to Claude, a thread flag when a run fails, and a wake source agents wait on for a run to finish.

commands.name: rerun-failed
commands.title: Rerun Failed Jobs
commands.description: Rerun the failed jobs of the newest failed GitHub Actions run of the thread's pull request (or of --run).

args.name: run
args.description: Run id (default: the newest failed run on the pull request's head)

args.name: thread
args.description: The thread whose pull request (default: the active one)

commands.name: rerun
commands.title: Rerun All Jobs
commands.description: Rerun every job of the newest finished GitHub Actions run of the thread's pull request (or of --run).

args.name: run
args.description: Run id (default: the newest finished run on the pull request's head)

args.name: thread
args.description: The thread whose pull request (default: the active one)

commands.name: cancel
commands.title: Cancel Run
commands.description: Cancel the GitHub Actions run in progress on the thread's pull request (or --run).
commands.confirm: Cancel the GitHub Actions run in progress on this pull request?

args.name: run
args.description: Run id (default: the newest run in progress on the pull request's head)

args.name: thread
args.description: The thread whose pull request (default: the active one)

commands.name: send-failure
commands.title: Send Failure to Claude
commands.description: Send the failed step's log of the newest failed GitHub Actions run of the thread's pull request (or --run, --job) to Claude in the thread.

args.name: run
args.description: Run id (default: the newest failed run on the pull request's head)

args.name: job
args.description: Job id (default: the run's first failed job with a log)

args.name: thread
args.description: The thread to send to, whose pull request it is (default: the active one)

commands.name: open
commands.title: Open Run on GitHub
commands.description: Open the thread's pull request's GitHub Actions run in the browser: the one in progress, else the failed one, else the newest (or --run).

args.name: run
args.description: Run id (default: the run the panel would show first)

args.name: thread
args.description: The thread whose pull request (default: the active one)

wakes.name: run-finished
wakes.title: Workflow run finished
wakes.description: A GitHub Actions run on the pull request's head commit completed (each run attempt once). The payload has the run id, name, number, attempt, status, conclusion, URL, failed jobs and how many runs are still going.

args.name: run
args.description: Only this run id (default: every run on the head)
